study_area: Dima Hasao District, Assam + 50 km Study Buffer
attribution: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center — Cooperative Open Online Landslide Repository (COOLR) / Global Landslide Catalog (Kirschbaum et al., 2010, 2015; Juang et al., 2019). Public domain / open NASA Earthdata resource.

deduplication_policy.rule_2: Same event_date and Haversine distance <= 250 m

scientific_uncertainty_assessment: NASA COOLR Reports Points are predominantly compiled from news media and disaster reports with geocoded location_accuracy ranging from 1 km to 50 km (plus 'unknown'). COOLR_Events_Points (satellite-mapped inventories) contains 0 records inside Dima Hasao or its 50 km buffer. Therefore, retrieved COOLR records inside Dima Hasao are scientifically valid for contextual mapping and coarse regional rainfall-trigger exploration, NOT as 30 m/90 m slope-scale ML training labels.
